title: Why Your House Isn't Your Best Investment
hook_text: YOUR HOUSE IS NOT AN INVESTMENT

beats.say: Your house isn't your best investment. It's just an expensive place to sleep.
beats.visual: A cinematic wide shot of a single suburban house at dusk, lit by a single warm porch light, shadows stretching across a quiet street, moody moody atmosphere.

beats.say: Most people think buying property is a guaranteed path to wealth.
beats.visual: A close-up shot of a brass front door handle with a metal key resting on a wooden console table, dimly lit with moody ambient side lighting.

beats.say: They forget about maintenance costs, property taxes, and home insurance.
beats.visual: A close-up shot of a hand using a wrench on a copper plumbing pipe under a dark sink, cinematic moody lighting, shallow depth of field.

beats.say: Then there's the hidden loss of opportunity cost.
beats.visual: An overhead shot of a wooden desk with a stack of old paper bills, a pen, and a closed black leather notebook, moody shadows.

beats.say: If you put $500 a month into the market at 8% a year for 30 years...
beats.visual: A close-up shot of a vintage metal desk lamp casting a warm circle of light on a blank wooden tabletop, dark background.
A close-up shot of a dark graph line printed on aged parchment paper, softly blurred in the background, cinematic low-key lighting.

beats.say: But here's the part nobody mentions.
beats.visual: A cinematic shot of a single house key resting on a dark concrete windowsill, morning fog outside the glass, moody and quiet.

beats.say: Your primary home doesn't pay you monthly dividends.
beats.visual: A close-up shot of a closed wooden front door viewed from the inside hallway, thin lines of bright sunlight cutting through the darkness.

beats.say: You only see that money when you sell and buy something else just as expensive.
beats.visual: A close-up shot of a hand locking a heavy deadbolt on a dark wooden door, moody cinematic side lighting.

beats.say: Treat your home as shelter first.
beats.visual: A wide cinematic shot of a cozy living room corner with a reading chair, dark walls, lit by a single floor lamp casting warm shadows.

beats.say: Follow for the money rules school never taught you...
beats.visual: A close-up shot of a dark wooden staircase leading upwards into shadows, minimal design, moody and atmospheric.

caption: A house is shelter first. Stop calling it an investment and look at the real math. #money #personalfinance #wealth #realestate #investing
description: Your house is not your best investment. Between maintenance, taxes, and opportunity cost, the math tells a different story.
first_comment: Do you view your home as an investment or just a place to live? Let's talk about it below.

facts.basis: MONEY FACT SHEET: $500/month for 30 years at 8%/yr equals $745,180.
